text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Tenno Sho (Spring), taking on 
prestigious rivals, Ines Fujin snatched 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she soared with joy, the defeated 
Mejiro Ryan turned to the fans, offering 
rousing words to fire both them and 
herself up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin watched that scene. Feeling the 
gap between herself and Mejiro Ryan, she 
began to reflect on how to face the cheers 
of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she become like Mejiro Ryan? To help 
her find that answer, let's build up her 
training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
